title: What range gives you
hints: With one loop variable, range over a slice gives the index, not the element. Over a string, s[i] is a byte, not a character.
for _, n := range nums gives the elements. Ranging over a string with two variables, for _, r := range s, decodes one rune (Unicode code point) at a time.
Sum: for _, n := range nums { total += n }. CountRunes: for _, r := range s { counts[r]++ }.
